filters.name: Select All
filters.shortDescription: Select all the faces/vertices of the current mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select all the faces/vertices of the current mesh.

parameters.label: Select all Faces
parameters.help: If true the filter will select all the faces.

parameters.label: Select all Vertices
parameters.help: If true the filter will select all the vertices.

filters.name: Select None
filters.shortDescription: Clear the current set of selected faces/vertices.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Clear the current set of selected faces/vertices.

parameters.label: De-select all Faces
parameters.help: If true the filter will de-select all the faces.

parameters.label: De-select all Vertices
parameters.help: If true the filter will de-select all the vertices.

filters.name: Select Faces by View Angle
filters.shortDescription: Select faces according to angle with view direction.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select faces according to the angle between their normal and the view direction. It is used in range map processing to select and delete steep faces parallel to viewdirection.

parameters.label: Angle Threshold (deg)
parameters.help: Faces with normals at higher angle w.r.t. the view direction are selected.

parameters.label: Use ViewPoint from Mesh Camera
parameters.help: Uses the ViewPoint from the camera associated to the current mesh. If there is no camera, an error occurs.

parameters.label: ViewPoint
parameters.help: Viewpoint position (ignored when UseCamera is true).

filters.name: Select 'Problematic' Faces
filters.shortDescription: Select problematic faces: elongated, flipped, or folded.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select faces with 'problems', like normal inverted w.r.t the surrounding areas, extremely elongated or folded.

parameters.label: Select by Aspect Ratio
parameters.help: If true, faces with aspect ratio below the limit will be selected.

parameters.label: Aspect Ratio
parameters.help: Triangle face aspect ratio [1 (equilateral) - 0 (line)]: face is selected if below this threshold.

parameters.label: Select by Normal Angle
parameters.help: If true, adjacent faces with normals forming an angle above the limit are selected.

parameters.label: Angle Flip
parameters.help: Angle between adjacent faces: face is selected if above this threshold.

parameters.label: Select Folded Faces
parameters.help: If true, folded faces created by quadric edge-collapse decimation are selected.

parameters.label: Folded Faces Angle Threshold
parameters.help: Angle between face normal and best-fitting plane of neighboring vertices. If above threshold, face is selected.

filters.name: Invert Selection
filters.shortDescription: Invert the current set of selected faces/vertices.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Invert the current set of selected faces/vertices.

parameters.label: Invert Faces
parameters.help: If true the filter will invert the set of selected faces.

parameters.label: Invert Vertices
parameters.help: If true the filter will invert the set of selected vertices.

filters.name: Select Connected Faces
filters.shortDescription: Expand selected faces to their connected components.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Expand the current face selection so that it includes all the faces in the connected components where there is at least a selected face.

filters.name: Select Faces from Vertices
filters.shortDescription: Transfer selection from selected vertices to faces.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select faces from selected vertices.

parameters.label: Strict Selection
parameters.help: If true only faces with all selected vertices are selected. Otherwise any face with at least one selected vertex is selected.

filters.name: Select Vertices from Faces
filters.shortDescription: Transfer selection from selected faces to vertices.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select vertices from selected faces.

parameters.label: Strict Selection
parameters.help: If true only vertices with all incident faces selected are selected. Otherwise any vertex with at least one incident selected face is selected.

filters.name: Delete Selected Vertices
filters.shortDescription: Delete selected vertices; incident faces are deleted too.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Delete the current set of selected vertices; faces that share one of the deleted vertices are deleted too.

filters.name: Delete ALL Faces
filters.shortDescription: Delete all faces, turning mesh into point cloud.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Delete ALL faces, turning the mesh into a pointcloud. May be applied also to all visible layers.

parameters.label: Apply to all visible Layers
parameters.help: If true, filter is applied to all visible mesh layers.

filters.name: Delete Selected Faces
filters.shortDescription: Delete selected faces; unreferenced vertices are not deleted.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Delete the current set of selected faces, vertices that remains unreferenced are not deleted.

filters.name: Delete Selected Faces and Vertices
filters.shortDescription: Delete selected faces and enclosed selected vertices.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Delete the current set of selected faces and all the vertices surrounded by that faces.

filters.name: Erode Selection
filters.shortDescription: Erode (reduce) current selected faces.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Erode (reduce) the current set of selected faces.

filters.name: Dilate Selection
filters.shortDescription: Dilate (expand) current selected faces.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Dilate (expand) the current set of selected faces.

filters.name: Select Border
filters.shortDescription: Select vertices and faces on mesh boundary.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select vertices and faces on the boundary.

filters.name: Select by Face Quality
filters.shortDescription: Select elements using per-face quality range.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select all the faces/vertices with within the specified face quality range.

parameters.label: Min Quality
parameters.help: Minimum acceptable quality value.

parameters.label: Max Quality
parameters.help: Maximum acceptable quality value.

parameters.label: Inclusive Selection
parameters.help: If true only vertices with all adjacent faces within range are selected. Otherwise any vertex with at least one face in range is selected.

filters.name: Select by Vertex Quality
filters.shortDescription: Select elements using per-vertex quality range.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select all the faces/vertices within the specified vertex quality range.

parameters.label: Min Quality
parameters.help: Minimum acceptable quality value.

parameters.label: Max Quality
parameters.help: Maximum acceptable quality value.

parameters.label: Inclusive Face Selection
parameters.help: If true only faces with all vertices within range are selected. Otherwise any face with at least one vertex in range is selected.

filters.name: Select Faces by Color
filters.shortDescription: Select part of the mesh based on vertex color.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select part of the mesh based on its color.

parameters.label: Color To Select
parameters.help: Color that you want to be selected.

parameters.label: Pick Color Space
parameters.help: The color space that the sliders will manipulate.

parameters.label: Inclusive Selection
parameters.help: If true only faces with all vertices within range are selected. Otherwise any face with at least one vertex in range is selected.

parameters.label: Variation from Red or Hue
parameters.help: A float in [0,1] representing accepted variation from selected Red/Hue.

parameters.label: Variation from Green or Saturation
parameters.help: A float in [0,1] representing accepted variation from selected Green/Saturation.

parameters.label: Variation from Blue or Value
parameters.help: A float in [0,1] representing accepted variation from selected Blue/Value.

filters.name: Select Self Intersecting Faces
filters.shortDescription: Select only self intersecting faces.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select only self intersecting faces.

filters.name: Select Vertex Texture Seams
filters.shortDescription: Select vertices on texture seams.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Colorize only border edges.

filters.name: Select non Manifold Edges
filters.shortDescription: Select faces and vertices incident on non manifold edges.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select the faces and the vertices incident on non manifold edges (e.g. edges where more than two faces are incident); note that this function select the components that

filters.name: Select non Manifold Vertices
filters.shortDescription: Select non manifold vertices.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select the non manifold vertices that do not belong to non manifold edges. For example two cones connected by their apex. Vertices incident on non manifold edges are ignored.

filters.name: Select Faces with Edges Longer Than...
filters.shortDescription: Select all triangles having an edge longer than threshold.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Select all triangles having an edge with length greater or equal than a given threshold.

parameters.label: Edge Threshold
parameters.help: Faces with an edge longer than this threshold will be selected.

filters.name: Select Outliers
filters.shortDescription: Select outlier vertices using LoOP.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Select the vertex classified as outlier using Local Outlier Propabilty measure described in:
'LoOP: Local Outlier Probabilities' Kriegel et al.
CIKM 2009

parameters.label: Probability
parameters.help: Threshold to select a vertex. Vertex is selected if LoOP value is above threshold.

parameters.label: Number of neighbors
parameters.help: Number of neighbors used to compute LoOP.
